paragraphs.source_en: Akechi Hyūga-no-kami Mitsuhide's hatred of Nobunaga's brutal nature swept the realm into a terrifying tempest. Ideals often drive reality down a tragic road of no return, and this time was no exception.

units.source_en: Akechi Hyūga-no-kami Mitsuhide's hatred of Nobunaga's brutal nature swept the realm into a terrifying tempest.
units.source_zh: 明智日向守光秀憎恨信长残暴的性格，把天下卷入了一股可怕的飓风之中。

units.source_en: Ideals often drive reality down a tragic road of no return, and this time was no exception.
units.source_zh: 理想常常把现实赶上悲惨的不归路，这次也不例外。

paragraphs.source_zh: 明智日向守光秀憎恨信长残暴的性格，把天下卷入了一股可怕的飓风之中。理想常常把现实赶上悲惨的不归路，这次也不例外。

paragraphs.source_en: From the moment they learned that Mitsuhide had rebelled against Nobunaga, daimyos, townspeople, and farmers alike once more pictured an age of chaos and sprang into action.

units.source_en: From the moment they learned that Mitsuhide had rebelled against Nobunaga, daimyos, townspeople, and farmers alike once more pictured an age of chaos and sprang into action.
units.source_zh: 从获知光秀谋叛信长的那一刻起，无论是大名、市民还是农夫，脑中都再次浮现出乱世之景象，并且行动起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从获知光秀谋叛信长的那一刻起，无论是大名、市民还是农夫，脑中都再次浮现出乱世之景象，并且行动起来。

paragraphs.source_en: As Ieyasu's party headed northeast from Moriguchi toward Tsuda in northern Kawachi, bands of robbers large and small had already cast a wide net along the Yodo River, peering furtively in every direction as they waited for prey.

units.source_en: As Ieyasu's party headed northeast from Moriguchi toward Tsuda in northern Kawachi, bands of robbers large and small had already cast a wide net along the Yodo River, peering furtively in every direction as they waited for prey.

paragraphs.source_en: Such whispers could be heard everywhere; every highway, ferry crossing, and mountain path had become an ambush ground for ruffians who knew the local terrain.

units.source_en: Such whispers could be heard everywhere; every highway, ferry crossing, and mountain path had become an ambush ground for ruffians who knew the local terrain.

paragraphs.source_en: When Ieyasu's party turned north near Kamimabushi in Neyagawa, three or four packs of wolves were already shadowing them in secret. Fortunately, just as they were about to cross the Neyagawa, the robbers spotted better prey than Ieyasu's party and went away.

units.source_en: Fortunately, just as they were about to cross the Neyagawa, the robbers spotted better prey than Ieyasu's party and went away.

paragraphs.source_en: The place was dangerous indeed. A steep precipice rose on the right, and a dense bamboo grove filled the left. At midnight, a fine rain began to fall from the sullen, pitch-black sky.

units.source_en: The place was dangerous indeed.
units.source_zh: 此地确实凶险。

paragraphs.source_zh: “说得也是……”秀一先避了避对方的锋芒，“听起来似乎有些道理，仔细一想，却不合情理。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How does it make no sense?”

units.source_en: “How does it make no sense?”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哪里不合情理？”

paragraphs.source_en: “If burning, killing, and plunder are a warrior's natural calling, there can be nothing improper in our waiting here until you finish robbing them and then robbing you in turn, can there?”

units.source_en: “If burning, killing, and plunder are a warrior's natural calling, there can be nothing improper in our waiting here until you finish robbing them and then robbing you in turn, can there?”
units.source_zh: “如果说烧杀抢掠是武士的本性，我们在这里等你们抢完，再抢劫你们，也没什么不合适吧？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “如果说烧杀抢掠是武士的本性，我们在这里等你们抢完，再抢劫你们，也没什么不合适吧？”

paragraphs.source_en: “You cannot put it that way. Our comrades shed so much blood and suffered so many wounds to obtain those things. How could we surrender them to you so easily?”

units.source_en: “You cannot put it that way.
units.source_zh: “话不能这么说。

units.source_en: Our comrades shed so much blood and suffered so many wounds to obtain those things. How could we surrender them to you so easily?”

paragraphs.source_en: “You need only hand over the swords, is that right? Wait a moment. Let us discuss it.”

paragraphs.source_en: Relations between people sometimes defy ordinary reason and fall under the sway of a certain atmosphere. Had the other men known they were travelers, they would surely have bared their fangs and risked their lives to attack. Yet once they became confederates with a common purpose, a strange sense of fellowship arose, transforming the mood entirely.

units.source_en: Relations between people sometimes defy ordinary reason and fall under the sway of a certain atmosphere.
units.source_zh: 人与人的关系有时不能以常理来衡量，而会受到某种气氛的支配。

units.source_en: Had the other men known they were travelers, they would surely have bared their fangs and risked their lives to attack.
units.source_zh: 对方若知道自己是旅人，一定会露出利牙，豁出命来袭击。

units.source_en: Yet once they became confederates with a common purpose, a strange sense of fellowship arose, transforming the mood entirely.
units.source_zh: 可是，当成为有了共同目的的同伙后，就会生出一种奇妙的义气，气氛为之一变。

paragraphs.source_zh: 人与人的关系有时不能以常理来衡量，而会受到某种气氛的支配。对方若知道自己是旅人，一定会露出利牙，豁出命来袭击。可是，当成为有了共同目的的同伙后，就会生出一种奇妙的义气，气氛为之一变。

paragraphs.source_en: “Give them the swords, and we will take another road. The swords were not our object anyway. We took only four or five of them.”

units.source_en: “Give them the swords, and we will take another road.
units.source_zh: “把刀交给他们，我们换条道去。

units.source_en: The swords were not our object anyway. We took only four or five of them.”
units.source_zh: 反正，刀并不是我们的目的，只不过抢了四五把。”

paragraphs.source_en: Two or three men who looked like leaders put their heads together; before long, they threw the stolen swords onto the rain-soaked mountain road and withdrew.

paragraphs.source_en: When the Kai Genji fell, Anayama Baisetsu alone had been fortunate enough to survive. Who could have imagined that he too would follow Katsuyori in death, slain by bandits in a desolate wilderness?

paragraphs.source_en: The party once more hastened eastward.
